remediation.tier2_cf_challenge: Cloudflare bot protection challenged the scanner. Set up the one-time WAF exemption in AI Assets Scanner settings. Free Cloudflare plan: also turn Bot Fight Mode off during scans (a Skip rule cannot bypass it). Alternative rule key for admins: skip on query strings containing cu_scan_token.
remediation.tier2_akamai_challenge: Akamai Bot Manager blocked the scan. Ask your CDN admin to allowlist requests carrying the x-cu-scanner header (value: your Scanner Secret, shown in AI Assets Scanner settings).
remediation.tier2_imperva_challenge: Imperva/Incapsula blocked the scan. Ask your security admin to allowlist requests carrying the x-cu-scanner header (value: your Scanner Secret, shown in AI Assets Scanner settings).
remediation.tier2_waf_challenge: A firewall/WAF challenged the scanner. Wordfence: enable Learning Mode during scans, or allowlist the scanner. Behind a CDN: set up the exemption in AI Assets Scanner settings.
remediation.tier2_unknown_challenge: Unidentified bot protection denied the scanner. Try the CDN exemption in AI Assets Scanner settings, or temporarily disable bot protection during scans.
remediation.tier2_rocket_loader_stub: Cloudflare Rocket Loader served a stub page to the scanner. The WAF exemption rule in AI Assets Scanner settings also skips this.
remediation.tier2_small_body: The site served a reduced page to the scanner (likely bot protection). Set up the CDN exemption in AI Assets Scanner settings, or temporarily disable bot protection during scans.
remediation.tier1_zero_bytes: Empty response. Check your host/WAF security logs for blocked requests, then re-scan.
remediation.tier1_http_4xx: The site denied the request. Check security-plugin blocklists or IP bans — allowlist by the x-cu-scanner header, not by IP (scanner IPs change).
remediation.tier1_http_5xx: The server errored. Re-scan later; if persistent, check site health and host status.
remediation.tier1_http_rate_limit: Your server rate-limited the scanner. Wait a few minutes between scans, or temporarily raise rate limits during scans. Behind Cloudflare or another CDN: set up the scanner exemption in AI Assets Scanner settings.
remediation.tier1_transport_error: The site was unreachable (DNS/TLS/timeout). Verify the URL loads from outside your network, then re-scan.

heading: Some pages couldn't be fully scanned
dismiss: Got it — don't show again for this scan

blocked.desktop: Desktop scanner blocked on %1$d of %2$d pages.
blocked.mobile: Mobile scanner blocked on %1$d of %2$d pages.

action.bot_one: Your bot protection denied the %1$s scanner. For %1$s rules too, temporarily disable bot protection during scans and re-scan.
action.bot_both: Your bot protection denied the scanner. For full coverage, temporarily disable bot protection during scans and re-scan.
action.bot_link: Behind Cloudflare or another CDN? Set up the scanner exemption so future scans aren't blocked — open AI Assets Scanner settings.
action.bot_link_rate: Behind Cloudflare or another CDN? Set up the scanner rate-limit exemption so future scans aren't throttled — open AI Assets Scanner settings.
action.error: Your server returned an error or didn't respond. Try again later, or check site health.
action.rate_cf: Cloudflare rate-limited the scan. Whoever manages your Cloudflare — you, your host, or your agency — needs to allowlist the scanner.
action.rate_cf_link: If you manage the Cloudflare account yourself, set up the one-time scanner exemption — open AI Assets Scanner settings.
action.rate_host: Your host's server rate-limited the scan. A CDN or WAF exemption will not help here. Wait a few minutes between scans, or ask your host to raise the rate limit during scans.
action.rate_unknown: The scan was rate-limited. Wait a few minutes between scans.
action.rate_unknown_link: If a CDN or WAF sits in front of your site, ask whoever manages it to allowlist the scanner; otherwise check your own server's rate limits — open AI Assets Scanner settings.
action.siteground: SiteGround's bot protection denied the scanner. Turn off the anti-bot protection in SiteGround Site Tools while the scan runs, or ask SiteGround support to allow the scanner, then re-scan.
